explication: UniLab is configurable robot-reinforcement-learning infrastructure: users select a task, simulator backend, and learning algorithm, then train or evaluate through a shared CLI. The central runtime builds a manager-based environment over a simulator contract and exposes it to learner runtimes; task-specific manager terms encode locomotion and motion-tracking semantics. The README also documents replay-based off-policy learning, backend swapping, playback, and sim-to-sim evaluation. Some links reflect README-level workflow rather than inspected call sites; unsampled implementation details are not inferred.
